title: A plain data question
question: How did delivery compare with the counter last week?
expected: One SQL query, completed orders only, in the restaurant's local time.
Says which week the figures cover and how it defined delivery and counter.

trace.question: How did delivery compare with the counter last week?
trace.answer:
Last week (Monday Oct 12 to Sunday Oct 18, 2026, local time, completed orders only), delivery was far bigger than the counter.

| | Delivery | Counter (in-store) |
|---|---|---|
| Orders | 883 | 113 |
| Gross sales | $28,047.59 | $2,267.01 |
| Average order | about $31.76 | about $20.06 |
| Discounts | $1,367.59 | $127.02 |
| Items sold | 2,096 | 250 |

Delivery brought in roughly 12 times the gross sales of the counter, on about 8 times as many orders. Each delivery order was also about $11.70 larger on average.

I took "delivery" to mean orders with a fulfillment type of delivery, and "the counter" to mean in-store orders. I also read "last week" as the previous Monday-to-Sunday week.

detail.purpose: Compare delivery vs in-store completed orders, Oct 12-18 2026 local time
detail.sql: SELECT fulfillment_type, count(*) orders, sum(gross_sales_cents) gross, sum(discount_cents) disc, round(avg(gross_sales_cents)) avg_gross, sum(item_count) items FROM orders WHERE state='completed' AND fulfillment_type IN ('delivery','in_store') AND (created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM merchants))::date BETWEEN '2026-10-12' AND '2026-10-18' GROUP BY 1

SELECT fulfillment_type, COUNT(*) AS orders, SUM(gross_sales_cents) AS gross, SUM(discount_cents) AS disc, ROUND(AVG(gross_sales_cents)) AS avg_gross, SUM(item_count) AS items FROM (SELECT * FROM orders WHERE merchant_id = 1) AS orders WHERE state = 'completed' AND fulfillment_type IN ('delivery', 'in_store') AND CAST((created_at AT TIME ZONE (SELECT timezone FROM (SELECT * FROM merchants WHERE id = 1) AS merchants)) AS DATE) BETWEEN '2026-10-12' AND '2026-10-18' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 500
